title: SSD swap in a desktop PC

steps.text: Power the PC down, unplug the power cable and clip the antistatic wrist strap to bare metal.
steps.visual_check: Power cable disconnected, strap clipped to bare metal

steps.text: Remove the two rear thumbscrews and slide the side panel off the desktop case.
Unplug the SATA data cable from the old SSD.
steps.visual_check: Data cable clear of the drive

steps.text: Unplug the SATA power cable from the old SSD.
steps.visual_check: Power cable clear of the drive

steps.text: Remove the two mounting screws with the Phillips screwdriver and slide the old SSD out of the bay.
steps.visual_check: Empty drive bay, old SSD on the bench

steps.text: Slide the new SSD into the bay and fasten the two mounting screws with the Phillips screwdriver.
steps.visual_check: New SSD seated flush, both screws fitted

steps.text: Plug the SATA data cable into the new SSD.
steps.visual_check: Data cable latched on the drive

steps.text: Plug the SATA power cable into the new SSD.
steps.visual_check: Power cable fully seated on the drive

steps.text: Refit the side panel and tighten the two rear thumbscrews.
Reconnect the power cable and boot the machine to confirm the new SSD is detected.
steps.visual_check: OS storage view lists the new SSD
